text: A song of ascents. Of David. I I rejoiced when they said to me,"Let us go to the house of the Lord." [AA]
And now our feet are standingwithin your gates, Jerusalem.
Jerusalem, built as a city,walled round about. [1] [AB]
There the tribes go up,the tribes of the Lord,As it was decreed for Israel,to give thanks to the name of the Lord. [AC]
There are the thrones of justice,the thrones of the house of David.
II For the peace of Jerusalem pray:"May those who love you prosper!
May peace be within your ramparts,prosperity within your towers." [AD]
For the sake of my brothers and friends I say,"Peace be with you." [AE]
For the sake of the house of the Lord, our God,I pray for your good.
